name: Rauth-Alm
beschreibung: The Rauth-Alm lies quietly in the Ötztal at about 1,600 meters above sea level, surrounded by alpine meadows and mountain forests. The inn combines traditional Tiroler hospitality with a cozy atmosphere – rustic parlors, a sun terrace, and regional cuisine with products from the surrounding area. Guests can go hiking in the mountains here or simply enjoy the peace away from the hustle and bustle. In winter, a groomed cross-country ski trail passes by nearby.
